# Aegis IAM

Aegis IAM is the corporate identity and access platform for employees, customers,
applications, and auditors. This book demonstrates engineering as code: the
canonical graph preserves needs, requirements, architecture decisions,
architecture, implementation, tests, and evidence in one verifiable chain. The
showcase is published as a Quarto Book [@quarto2026], so requirements engineering
artifacts and conventional scholarly citations coexist in the same source tree.
